description: PLA ad request / non-zero-response volume and response rate for a marketplace over a period, grouped by any combination of the dimensions below: supply network, store, page type, page name, device, product category (L1-L5 or the concatenated category path), day of month, or hour of day. Replaces the three single-grain PLA RR reports. Group by category_l1/l2/l3 for category RR, by store_id + category + day + hour for the store-hour eligibility buckets, or by any other dimension mix. Pass a NOT IN ('', 'NA') filter on the grouping column to reproduce the null/blank guards the retired reports hardcoded.

network.description: The supply network / channel the ad request came from.

store_id.description: The store the ad request was attributed to.

page_type.description: The surface the ad served on (SEARCH, CATEGORY, PRODUCT, HOME, ...).

page_name.description: The specific page name the ad request was attributed to.

device.description: The device type the ad request came from (mobile, desktop, app, ...).

category_l1.description: Top-level (L1) product category the requests/responses were attributed to.

category.description: Category hierarchy path (L1 > L2 > L3) the requests/responses were attributed to; 'na' where a level is missing.

day.description: Day-of-month (1-31) derived via EXTRACT(DAY FROM r.date_hour); used with hour to form the store-hour bucketing grain.

hour.description: Hour-of-day (0-23) derived via EXTRACT(HOUR FROM r.date_hour); used with day to form the store-hour bucketing grain.

requests.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.requests ELSE 0 END), 0)
requests.description: Ad requests received for this dimension grouping.

responses.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.non_zero_responses ELSE 0 END), 0)
responses.description: Requests that returned at least one ad (non-zero responses) for this dimension grouping.

response_rate.selector: SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.non_zero_responses ELSE 0 END) * 100, NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.requests ELSE 0 END), 0))
response_rate.description: Response rate (%) = non-zero responses / requests * 100 for this dimension grouping.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_product_ads_filtered_level_report` AS r JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON r.marketplace_client_id = mc.marketplace_client_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
